description: Find published The2410 case studies relevant to the customer's current software project. Use this tool when the user wants examples of similar work or relevant project experience. The tool uses the existing project context and returns up to five case studies, ordered by relevance. It does not change the project context, plan, or estimate.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.
